model_details.name: Chennai Air Quality PM2.5 Walk-Forward Stacking Ensemble

intended_use.primary_use: Predicting next-day PM2.5 concentrations across Chennai monitoring stations and spatial grids.
intended_use.caveats: Forecast concentrations are not regulatory AQI without 24-hr averaging completeness. Sentinel-5P is an offline context feature.

ethical_considerations.transparency: Predictions are accompanied by SHAP feature attributions (via XGBoost surrogate component) and Ensemble Prediction Spread (Inter-Model Disagreement Range) with empirical holdout coverage measured at 52.28%.
ethical_considerations.health_advice: Non-diagnostic; informs public awareness without medical assertions.
